services.title: Custom Ironwork & Metal Projects
services.metaTitle: Custom Ironwork & Metal Projects in Southern Utah | D&S Iron Works
services.metaDescription: Plan custom ironwork with Dallan Goff at D&S Iron Works, including forged railings, fire pits, signs, furniture, metal art, and one-of-a-kind steel projects in Southern Utah.

gallery.alt: Custom forged iron table built by D&S Iron Works
Custom forged stair and balcony railing installed in a Utah home
Personalized steel sign made by D&S Iron Works

services.summary: D&S Iron Works plans and builds functional and decorative ironwork for homes, cabins, ranches, businesses, and gathering spaces across Southern and central Utah.
details: Direct project planning with Dallan Goff
Custom work for indoor, outdoor, decorative, and functional pieces

process.title: Share the idea
process.description: Bring a sketch, reference photo, measurements, or a rough concept for the space and intended use.

process.title: Plan it with Dallan
process.description: Discuss scale, steel details, finish, installation needs, and the practical requirements of the piece directly with Dallan.

process.title: Build and finish
process.description: The project is forged, formed, cut, assembled, and finished in the D&S Iron Works shop.

services.localServiceNote: D&S Iron Works serves customers throughout Southern and central Utah, including Cedar City, St. George, Beaver, Hurricane, and surrounding communities. Project fit and travel requirements are confirmed during the initial conversation.
